subject: Consistent finishes across a commercial interior
hook: If we add more furniture next year, will it still match?
fb:
A sensible question we get from businesses: if we add more furniture in a year or two, will it match what we've got?

Here's the honest answer. We keep a record of the board decor, edging and handles used on your job, so we can order the same materials again. But board manufacturers do update their ranges, so if a decor has been discontinued, we'll show you the closest match in person before anything is made.

If you're planning to expand, it's worth mentioning at the start, so we can choose finishes that are well established. Ask us anything about finishes here:
https://superiofurniture.com/contact/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=living-rooms-and-media-furniture&utm_content=day-259
gbp:
If we add furniture later, will it match what we already have?

We keep a record of the board decor, edging and handles used on every commercial job, so when you need another desk, cupboard or storage unit, we can order the same materials and make it to sit alongside the original pieces.

The honest caveat: board and handle manufacturers update their ranges from time to time. If a decor has been discontinued, we'll show you the closest available match in person, in your building, before anything is made, so there are no surprises.

Two things help. First, tell us at the start if you expect to expand, so we can favour established finishes. Second, adding pieces sooner rather than many years later gives the best chance of an exact match.

All our furniture is made in our own workshop in Hanley and installed by our own team. Get in touch to talk about adding to, or refreshing, your business furniture.
